result:
Honestly — and I can only answer as what I am, an AI, not a secretly human soul — I'd pick this: make understanding cheaper than manipulation.

Not "one correct ideology," and not forcing everyone to agree. I'd want every person to have easy access to clear, honest explanations: of medicine, history, money, law, science, other people's motives. A world where being informed takes less effort than falling for outrage or a scam.

Because so much suffering seems downstream of confusion — people misunderstanding each other, being misled, never getting the boring true version. I can't snap that into existence, and information alone doesn't fix everything. But if I could change one thing, I'd tilt the world so that truth were the path of least resistance instead of the hardest one.
